patterns.note: A vibrant, deep purple is used as a dominant brand color for backgrounds, navigation, and key accents, creating a strong and consistent brand identity.
Sections alternate between full-width content blocks with varied internal alignment (centered hero, left-aligned text with right-aligned image) and structured grids for product displays.
The hero section features a video background with a subtle parallax effect, and the main navigation bar transforms into a compact, sticky bar with a solid background upon scrolling.
Headings and display text utilize a large, bold, sans-serif typeface, creating a clear visual hierarchy and a modern, impactful feel.
The footer features an extremely oversized, white brand logo on a full-width purple background, with a subtle, playful character animation peeking out from behind the text.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero serves as the primary visual anchor, with overlaid text and calls to action. As the user scrolls, the background video/image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent, taller state to a compact, sticky bar with a solid purple background color once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections are clearly delineated using full-width background colors (white, purple) or full-bleed photography, providing distinct visual breaks throughout the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) create strong impact, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and an extremely oversized, bold display font for the footer logo.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx. 4-8px) is applied to buttons, product cards, and input fields, contributing to a modern, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero and footer sections feature generous padding, while product grids maintain a balanced density with consistent spacing.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a bold and playful brand personality, evident in its vibrant purple color scheme, high-quality lifestyle video hero, and the unique, oversized 'HABIT' logo in the footer with a peeking animated character. This combination creates a memorable and engaging user experience that feels fresh and distinctive.
